section_summary.extract_value: This section describes use of the 10-item Body Acceptance by Others Scale (BAOS; Avalos & Tylka, 2006) to measure perceived acceptance of one's body from others. It notes response format, scoring (mean of items), prior validation in U.S. adults, and reports Cronbach's α values of .90 for women and .92 for men. No sample size, demographics, BMI data, correlations, survey method, or country information are provided.
section_summary.evidence_source: Participants were also asked to complete the 10-item Body Acceptance by Others Scale (BAOS; Avalos & Tylka, 2006). An overall score was computed as the mean of all items... In U.S. adults, BAOS scores have been found to have a one-dimensional factor structure... Here, Cronbach's α for this scale was .90 in women and .92 in men.
